findings.description: synthesis.json reports large_scc_size=3, but existing_srs_context.json has a 70-member strongly connected component (72 requirements in cycles, counting the FR-AUTH-004/FR-IAM-006 pair). cycles.pair also lists only FR-AUTH-004/FR-IAM-006, although shortest_cycle_length_histogram has four 2-cycles: FR-FLOW-006<->SEC-APIKEY-008, IR-TOKEN-001<->SEC-FLOW-004 and SEC-AUTH-001<->SEC-TOKEN-004 as well. I checked all four edges in the SRS Trace Links. The per-requirement handling is correct: all 72 in_dependency_cycle flags match the SCC membership, the in-cycle dependency_health scores are 6-11 against 10-15 out of the cycles, and the conditions mention edge cutting.
findings.suggested_action: Set cycles.large_scc_size to 70 and list all four 2-cycles in synthesis.json, so the scheduling impact reaches the user at the approval gate without being understated.

findings.req_id: FR-APIKEY-007, FR-APIKEY-009, PERF-APIKEY-001 (+50 others in existing_srs_context)
findings.description: existing_srs_context.json undercounts AC markers in 53 of 165 blocks. inferred_ac_count is 0 where the blocks carry [INFERRED] tags: SEC-TOKEN-001 has 4, SEC-AUTH-001 4, FR-TOKEN-003 4, SEC-TOKEN-008 4, FR-AUTH-002 2. name_not_final_count is also low for some: SEC-TOKEN-004 has 3 against 0, SEC-FLOW-014 2 against 0. The APIKEY ac_verifiability evidence repeats '0 INFERRED' from this file, which is false for FR-APIKEY-007, FR-APIKEY-009 and PERF-APIKEY-001. I read the ACs of 16 sampled requirements and every INFERRED tag there is ':advisory' or ':test-parameter', so the tests can still be written and the scores (10-14) do not contradict the ACs. The cited evidence is factually wrong, though.
findings.suggested_action: Recount the INFERRED and 'name not final' markers from the block text (Acceptance Criteria section only), then fix the APIKEY ac_verifiability evidence strings. No re-score is needed unless a recount turns up a non-advisory INFERRED.

findings.description: REL-FLOW-001 is medium (77) with the lowest implementability among the medium set (21). Its implementability evidence and conditions say that java.sql, DataSource and FileDescriptor.sync on API 21 are 'unconfirmed'. The gzip-decoded signature contains java/sql/Connection, java/sql/SQLException, javax/sql/DataSource, and FileDescriptor with sync()V. The APIKEY, TOKEN and IAM analysts already recorded these as present (for example FR-IAM-010 and SEC-APIKEY-003). The medium label may therefore partly rest on an uncertainty that is already resolved; +3 on implementability would make it 80 (high).
findings.suggested_action: Re-score REL-FLOW-001 implementability with the confirmed signature facts and keep only the real conditions (test-only sqlite-jdbc, injectable Android detection). Relabel it if the total reaches 80.
